compound-stability-universal-components.title: Compound stability with universal obligations
compound-stability-universal-components.when: An always-step conjunct is combined with universal fairness or action obligations
compound-stability-universal-components.avoid: Missing component premises or unproved conjunction-stability rule

always-conjunction-per-conjunct-stabilit.title: Left-nested always-conjunction stability
always-conjunction-per-conjunct-stabilit.when: The goal is stability of a left-nested conjunction of already always-wrapped predicates
always-conjunction-per-conjunct-stabilit.avoid: Absent or incompatible stability helpers, predicate shapes, or nesting

existing-stabilization-proof-object-lift.title: Finite lifted conjunction with local proof object
existing-stabilization-proof-object-lift.when: A finite always-lifted conjunction has existing local stability proof objects or a macro
existing-stabilization-proof-object-lift.avoid: Absent or incompatible proof objects, or predicates at the wrong lifting level

always-stability-extra-wrapper-precondit.title: Extra always wrapper in a helper precondition
always-stability-extra-wrapper-precondit.when: A conjunction-stability precondition fails after an already wrapped predicate was given to always-stability
always-stability-extra-wrapper-precondit.avoid: The exact contract expects that wrapper shape or other premises are missing

installed-library-lemma-direct.title: Existing library lemma matches the goal
installed-library-lemma-direct.when: A library lemma has the required algebraic conclusion and available premises
installed-library-lemma-direct.avoid: No matching lemma, missing premises, or incompatible equality form

original-card-003.title: Equal serialization to equal views
original-card-003.when: Marshalable values have equal serialization and an existing trait contract promises view equality
original-card-003.avoid: Trait unavailable or its view relation does not imply the required structural equality

original-card-043.title: Equal views to equal marshalability
original-card-043.when: Two datatype values have equal abstract views and the goal is equal marshalability predicates
original-card-043.avoid: Repeated direct calls when the view-equivalence declaration cannot instantiate; inspect fallback conditions

card-008-verbatim.title: Eventual action to post-state existence
card-008-verbatim.when: Eventual action occurrence is established but post-state existence still fails
card-008-verbatim.avoid: Unusable occurrence triggers or missing pointwise action-to-post implication

card-009-verbatim.title: Absolute witness to suffix eventual state
card-009-verbatim.when: A raw state witness at an absolute shifted index does not establish eventual satisfaction on the current suffix
card-009-verbatim.avoid: Unproved offset arithmetic or unavailable lifted-predicate unfolding

card-061-verbatim.title: Existential reachability witness
card-061-verbatim.when: A temporal branch has an existential reachability fact but a manual witness index is difficult
card-061-verbatim.avoid: The existential is unproved or its witness property cannot support the next step

finite-set-fold-finiteness-cardinality-i.title: Finiteness of a folded set
finite-set-fold-finiteness-cardinality-i.when: A fold over a finite input set must produce a finite set
finite-set-fold-finiteness-cardinality-i.avoid: No decreasing cardinality argument or unsuitable empty/nonempty fold equalities

finite-set-fold-image-equality-cardinali.title: Folded set equals a set image
finite-set-fold-image-equality-cardinali.when: A finite-cardinality recursive fold must equal the image of its finite source set
finite-set-fold-image-equality-cardinali.avoid: Source finiteness or finite-cardinality recursion is absent

card-015-verbatim.title: Method/field or missing-antecedent diagnostics
card-015-verbatim.when: New proof code confuses methods and fields, or warns that a quantified antecedent is not assumed
card-015-verbatim.avoid: Neither diagnostic is present; implication syntax is version-sensitive

card-028-verbatim.title: Function-field equality syntax or trigger failure
card-028-verbatim.when: Pointwise record equality fails on field-as-method syntax or uninferred quantifier triggers
card-028-verbatim.avoid: Treating pointwise agreement as record equality without establishing field equality

merged-field-projection-before-apply.title: Stored spec-function field called as a method
merged-field-projection-before-apply.when: A compile error reports no method for a function-valued field used with call-like dot syntax
merged-field-projection-before-apply.avoid: A genuine method, a non-function field, or a missing logical fact

concrete-empty-ghost-aggregate.title: Empty ghost aggregate obligation
concrete-empty-ghost-aggregate.when: An unconstrained ghost aggregate must have empty sequences and an empty derived set

concrete-empty-ghost-history-initializer.title: Empty ghost history at initialization
concrete-empty-ghost-history-initializer.when: The abstract initial-state relation requires an empty history currently initialized arbitrarily
concrete-empty-ghost-history-initializer.avoid: Nonempty history is required or the field affects executable behavior

loop-counting-termination-measure.title: Counting-loop termination diagnostic
loop-counting-termination-measure.when: A counter increments from zero to a collection length and Verus requests a decreases clause
loop-counting-termination-measure.avoid: Termination depends on other state or the measure does not decrease on every path

loop-body-inherited-assumption-invariant.title: Function assumptions unavailable inside a loop
loop-body-inherited-assumption-invariant.when: Termination is accepted but an inner precondition depends on function-entry assumptions
loop-body-inherited-assumption-invariant.avoid: The loop modifies relevant state so those assumptions are not preserved

packet-prefix-set-invariant.title: Packet-prefix loop set and validity obligations
packet-prefix-set-invariant.when: A packet-append prefix loop still fails set equality, invariants, or match-arm obligations after termination repair
packet-prefix-set-invariant.avoid: Repeating unchanged assertions when missing field or record premises remain

natural-predecessor-subtraction-conversi.title: Natural predecessor has integer type
natural-predecessor-subtraction-conversi.when: A natural-number induction helper gets an integer from predecessor subtraction
natural-predecessor-subtraction-conversi.avoid: The branch does not establish nonnegativity or safe conversion

empty-sequence-length-annotation.title: Empty sequence inference or length/index mismatch
empty-sequence-length-annotation.when: An empty sequence lacks an inferred element type or a natural length is used as an integer index
empty-sequence-length-annotation.avoid: Types are already determined or the interface accepts natural indices

rule-card-019.title: Fuel reveal rejected for a spec wrapper
rule-card-019.when: Fuel-based revealing is rejected for a spec function without a decreasing clause
rule-card-019.avoid: Direct revealing is supported or the original function needs no wrapper

rule-card-021.title: Opaque fixed-width serialization length
rule-card-021.when: A closed serialization function blocks a required fixed-width length fact
rule-card-021.avoid: No open counterpart or connector, or the spec avoids encoding details

rule-card-053.title: Length-prefixed serialization injectivity
rule-card-053.when: Injectivity needs a fixed header length and sequence equality but header assertions or early equality helpers fail
rule-card-053.avoid: No fixed-width header or installed encoding/decoding round-trip lemma

exec-shape-deghost-restore.title: Verified proof with executable-shape difference
exec-shape-deghost-restore.when: Verus succeeds but Lynette reports changed executable calls, bindings, branches, or returns
exec-shape-deghost-restore.avoid: The proof strategy genuinely needs executable changes; semantic equivalence alone is insufficient

module-scope-proof-directive-scope-down.title: Verified proof with module-scope directive difference
module-scope-proof-directive-scope-down.when: A proof-import-like directive at module scope causes a safety-comparison difference after verification
module-scope-proof-directive-scope-down.avoid: The directive is illegal locally or cannot be partitioned across dependent proofs

qualified-proof-helper-set-equality-no-i.title: Verified set proof with import or macro difference
qualified-proof-helper-set-equality-no-i.when: A set-equality proof verifies but safety comparison rejects a proof-only import or macro change
qualified-proof-helper-set-equality-no-i.avoid: A real executable, signature, or specification difference

post-verification-trigger-implication-wa.title: Warnings after successful verification
post-verification-trigger-implication-wa.when: The proof already verifies and only automatic-trigger or quantified-implication warnings remain
post-verification-trigger-implication-wa.avoid: An active quantifier or implication proof failure

qualified-proof-helper-macro-path.title: Proof helper or macro out of scope
qualified-proof-helper-macro-path.when: A proof-only helper or macro is unavailable locally and a new top-level import may violate preservation
qualified-proof-helper-macro-path.avoid: No usable installed qualified path, executable artifacts, or an already harmless import

sequence-equality-closure-qualified-path.title: Sequence-equality closure out of scope
sequence-equality-closure-qualified-path.when: A sequence-equality closure mechanism is unavailable or its proposed import fails safety comparison
sequence-equality-closure-qualified-path.avoid: No library-root export or the local import policy already permits it

missing-antecedent-quantified-proof.title: Diagnostic says quantified antecedent is not assumed
missing-antecedent-quantified-proof.when: An inner assertion or lemma fails with a missing-antecedent warning in a quantified proof
missing-antecedent-quantified-proof.avoid: The antecedent is already available, a different premise is missing, or the failure is trigger inference

quantified-binder-scope-verbatim.title: Binder or antecedent facts unavailable
quantified-binder-scope-verbatim.when: A quantified implication loses antecedent-dependent bounds or facts about its bound value
quantified-binder-scope-verbatim.avoid: Genuinely absent bounds or no binder/antecedent issue; syntax is version-sensitive

helper-precondition-implication-branch-v.title: Helper precondition inside quantified implication
helper-precondition-implication-branch-v.when: A helper precondition fails inside an implication-bearing quantified assertion
helper-precondition-implication-branch-v.avoid: Rewriting specification requires/ensures or a goal already discharged by a supplied case lemma

rule-card-004.title: Record equality from full pointwise field agreement
rule-card-004.when: Record equality is the failing postcondition and every index of a function-valued field already agrees
rule-card-004.avoid: Agreement covers only some indices or other record fields are not known equal

rule-card-005.title: Direct function-value equality remains unproved
rule-card-005.when: Full pointwise agreement exists but direct function equality and guessed helpers fail
rule-card-005.avoid: No installed extensional equality relation or incomplete pointwise agreement

seq-fold-concat-induction-second.title: Concatenated fold resists direct unfolding
seq-fold-concat-induction-second.when: A left fold over concatenation must equal concatenated separate folds and a direct proof fails
seq-fold-concat-induction-second.avoid: Non-associative or non-append-like accumulator operation, or missing prefix/last decomposition

seq-fold-concat-split-lemma-helper.title: Concatenated fold with a library split lemma
seq-fold-concat-split-lemma-helper.when: The fold can be split at the boundary between its two source sequences
seq-fold-concat-split-lemma-helper.avoid: No split lemma or incompatible accumulator-plus-empty formulation

rule-general-set-image-equality-witness.title: Set/image equality without a direct library lemma
rule-general-set-image-equality-witness.when: A membership equivalence or reverse-containment assertion does not establish set equality
rule-general-set-image-equality-witness.avoid: An applicable library lemma already proves the same goal with available premises

rule-no-duplicate-sequence-removal-set-e.title: Set view after duplicate-free sequence removal
rule-no-duplicate-sequence-removal-set-e.when: Removing an index from a duplicate-free sequence must equal removing that element from its set view
rule-no-duplicate-sequence-removal-set-e.avoid: Duplicates are possible or the removed element occurs at another index

card-016-verbatim.title: Existential message states with per-message lemmas
card-016-verbatim.when: Trusted per-message leads-to lemmas do not connect existential statement-level state conditions
card-016-verbatim.avoid: No per-witness lemma or no witness selectable from atomic state membership/equality

card-032-verbatim.title: Existential intermediate states with witness helpers
card-032-verbatim.when: A leads-to source or intermediate state is existential but helpers cover only individual witnesses
card-032-verbatim.avoid: Unavailable or uninstantiable helpers; individual legs alone may leave final transitivity open

card-033-verbatim.title: Existential temporal predicate equality
card-033-verbatim.when: Temporal equality involves an existential and existing equality and witness-introduction rules
card-033-verbatim.avoid: Either trusted rule is missing or an antecedent is not available in the proof block

card-029-verbatim.title: Universal/always commutation equality
card-029-verbatim.when: Temporal equality has existing universal-commutation and always-moving helpers
card-029-verbatim.avoid: Global unfolding, new trusted rules, or undischarged helper preconditions

card-070-verbatim.title: Single versus nested temporal operator
card-070-verbatim.when: The failing postcondition equates one application of a temporal/spec operator with two applications
card-070-verbatim.avoid: Built-in equality already suffices or the required index-shift identity is unavailable

nested-always-forward-shift-helper.title: Nested always with an existing suffix helper
nested-always-forward-shift-helper.when: An empty proof must establish nested always and the context supplies a forward-shift helper
nested-always-forward-shift-helper.avoid: Missing helper, insufficient unfolding, or a mismatching assumption

always-lifted-action-unfolding-helper.title: Always-lifted action to every suffix
always-lifted-action-unfolding-helper.when: An always-lifted action premise must yield suffix-wise satisfaction and an unfolding helper exists
always-lifted-action-unfolding-helper.avoid: The helper is absent or not already accepted without a new trusted body

card-010-verbatim.title: Temporal invariant with finite transition cases
card-010-verbatim.when: An empty proof must show that a specification entails a state predicate at every future point
card-010-verbatim.avoid: No induction rule, no finite step match, or a transition needs a missing invariant

card-011-verbatim.title: Network multiset message invariant
card-011-verbatim.when: Transitions remove at most one received message and add a multiset of sent messages
card-011-verbatim.avoid: Unconstrained message sources or arbitrary external messages without finite case analysis

card-012-verbatim.title: Controller cannot send its own external request
card-012-verbatim.when: The controller preservation case must exclude a request to its own external system
card-012-verbatim.avoid: Uninterpreted or request-producing reconciler, or uncovered external-system models

original-card-018.title: Trigger-inference or missing-antecedent diagnostic
original-card-018.when: An assertion or witness choice reports uninferred triggers or a weak-implication antecedent warning
original-card-018.avoid: Neither diagnostic is present or a genuine premise is missing; original wording tension is retained

original-card-034.title: Active trigger-inference failure
original-card-034.when: Verus cannot infer triggers for a quantified assertion or witness choice
original-card-034.avoid: The proof already verifies and only a low-confidence trigger note remains

original-card-057.title: Universal assertion trigger or antecedent warning
original-card-057.when: A universal assertion reports uninferred triggers or an implication antecedent not assumed
original-card-057.avoid: A new logical premise is needed; successful-proof warnings do not establish necessity

card-037-whole-sequence-element-helper.title: Whole-sequence fact missing at one index
card-037-whole-sequence-element-helper.when: A whole-sequence validity/range premise is available but an element assertion at the loop index fails
card-037-whole-sequence-element-helper.avoid: The index is not in bounds or the element property does not follow

card-058-entailment-implication-concrete.title: Entailment premise inactive at one execution
card-058-entailment-implication-concrete.when: An entailment/validity premise exists but asserting its conclusion at a concrete execution fails
card-058-entailment-implication-concrete.avoid: Mismatching execution type or implication surface form

card-076-alias-inline-trigger-instantiat.title: Alias facts miss quantified stability precondition
card-076-alias-inline-trigger-instantiat.when: A recursive helper fails stability after always-facts reached a suffix through local aliases
card-076-alias-inline-trigger-instantiat.avoid: Aliases do not affect matching or trusted quantified facts are absent
